- **Fleet Specifications**: Commercial 16-foot high-wall box trucks rated for up to 4.5 tons payload capacity.
- **Licensing & Motor Carrier Compliance**: Active Washington Department of Revenue (WA DOR) business registration (UBI Active); comprehensive commercial auto and general liability coverage.

## Core Value Propositions & Pricing Policy
- **Privately Owned & Operated**: Zero corporate franchise fees, delivering lower base rates than national chains.
- **10% Rate Guarantee**: Matches and lowers any verifiable local competitor's advertised or written price by 10%.
- **Minimum Booking Baseline**: $125 flat minimum for single-item curbside pickup.
- **Eco-Conscious Sorting**: Active sorting for recycling, donation, and scrap diversion before landfill dumping.
- **Rapid Response**: 30-second mobile quote submission and same-day/next-day dispatch options.

## Operational Constraints & Policy
- **Dispatch Cutoff**: Same-day requests must be confirmed before 1:00 PM PST.
- **Prohibited Hazardous Materials**: Wet paint, motor oils, asbestos, explosive munitions, biohazardous/medical chemicals.
- **Accepted Streams**: Furniture, mattresses, refrigerators, freezers, ovens, yard debris, construction remodeling scrap, electronics, sheds, hot tubs.

## Canonical Service Endpoints
- [Residential Junk Removal](https://www.mmjunk.com/#residential-services): Furniture, appliance recycling, yard waste, and estate cleanouts.
- [Commercial & Contractor Services](https://www.mmjunk.com/#commercial-services): Jobsite remodel scrap, warehouse cleanouts, office furniture, shed and hot tub demolition.
- [Eco-Disposal & Recycling Logistics](https://www.mmjunk.com/#eco-disposal): Transfer station routing, donation partnerships, and scrap metal recovery.
